note.en: If you do not have a Dutch diploma, check admission with a foreign diploma: a Nuffic credential evaluation is made and additional conditions may apply.

evidence.quote: Als je een niet-Nederlands diploma hebt, beoordeelt Hogeschool Leiden je diploma op toelaatbaarheid aan de hand van een diplomawaardering van Nuffic.

notes: The deadline of 1 May has no year in the quotes; it is given as recurringDeadline. Tuition is from the institution-wide page, as the programme page only mentions the statutory fee (wettelijk collegegeld). The institution-wide page does not state that the institutional fee applies to non-EU/EEA students in one sentence, but the definition of who does not qualify for the statutory fee (no EU/EEA/Swiss etc. nationality and no Dutch study-financing residence permit) covers a Moroccan applicant. The amount used is for 2027-2028, full-time; the same page also lists 2026-2027 (€ 9,556). Language proficiency: the programme is taught in Dutch; the B2-level certificate is one of the accepted proofs, but the page also mentions other possibilities (state exam NT2, TUL advanced) that are not listed as acceptedTests.
